display_name: Answer Validate Freeze Memorize Error Routine Blueprint
aliases: Show Project to AI recovery blueprint
description: Cross-project continuation wrapper that resumes the governed ZIP, install, validation, synchronization, Freeze, Error Memory, and final-answer lifecycle without retraining, while enforcing independently pasteable Windows PowerShell output.
trigger_phrases: finish zip install validate freeze error memory
when_to_load: When the user presses the Show Project to AI routine button, asks to finish the release lifecycle, or an AI stopped or failed between answer, ZIP, install, validation, synchronization, Freeze, Error Memory, and final reporting.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for explanation-only work that does not require lifecycle continuation or recovery.
do_not_regress: Embed the current selected Project and KANDA Reasoner Tool identities in the copied button text.
Keep all selected-Project source, staging, validation, Freeze, and Error Memory paths derived from the selected Project.
Keep canonical prompt source owned by the KANDA Reasoner Tool root.
Never deliver an isolated ZIP or claim installation as validation.
Continue from the last reliable marker without requiring the user to retrain the AI.
Keep Preview read-only and Confirm and Write and Memorize Error explicitly human governed.
Every user-facing PowerShell code fence must be one independently pasteable unit.
Prefer direct packaged script invocation and never emit user-facing else, elseif, or finally clauses.
Require Windows PowerShell 5.1-compatible APIs unless a newer runtime is explicitly verified.
Use the exact current artifact path rather than an assumed destination or placeholder path.
